stories.title: 美国化石燃料基建回暖：数据中心与工厂推高用电，可再生能源增速放缓
stories.sourceTitle: The fossil fuel comeback is here

stories.title: CoreWeave 债券跌入困境区间，AI 算力公司的债务风险外溢

stories.title: 纽约市长 Mamdani 批联邦政府在 AI 监管上缺位，呼吁市民抵制“AI 接管不可避免”叙事
stories.sourceTitle: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
stories.summary: 纽约市长 Zohran Mamdani 周一晚表示，纽约人应反对 AI 接管不可避免的说法，并要求出台保护公众、把权力交还民众的监管。
stories.analysis: AI 监管正从联邦层面下沉到城市政治，成为地方动员议题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

stories.title: Hugging Face 政策负责人：嵌入式 AI 评估员并非易行方案
stories.sourceTitle: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
stories.summary: 针对在 AI 组织内部安插“中立”第三方观察员的嵌入式评估思路，Hugging Face 政策负责人认为这不会是一个简单解法，背景是 AI 实验室接连面对安全事件。
stories.analysis: 外部评估机制的设计难点在于独立性、访问权和激励结构，而非口号。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the

stories.title: Nscale 与 Anthropic 据悉洽谈 450 亿美元算力交易
stories.sourceTitle: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
stories.summary: 若交易达成，这将是 Anthropic 过去一年签署的一系列巨额算力协议中的最新一笔。
stories.analysis: Anthropic 通过长期算力锁定扩张模型训练与推理供给，也加剧对资本和能源的依赖。
stories.sourceExcerpt: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

stories.title: Microsoft 称 AI Agent 类似内部威胁：前沿模型“不可信”，企业需监控员工所用代理
stories.sourceTitle: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
stories.summary: Microsoft 提醒企业密切关注员工在非 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 实验室控制的系统中使用的 Agent。
stories.analysis: Agent 权限扩散使传统边界安全失效，企业需要把代理当“内部人员”治理。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.title: 伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker：AI 可能让人活到 100 岁，也可能像核武器一样构成威胁
stories.sourceTitle: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes

stories.analysis: 州长级人物把 AI 与核风险并置，说明 AI 议题正进入主流政治议程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today, I’m talking with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, who has a lot of thoughts about AI, tech, and privacy. If you’ve been listening to the show, you know that one of my running theories is that those issues are driving a big and maybe kind of unexpected politic

stories.title: Amazon 推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具，挑战 NVIDIA 对 PyTorch 的控制
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
stories.summary: Amazon 希望打破 NVIDIA 对 PyTorch 这一主流 AI 开发工具包的控制，让更多开发者把应用跑在自家等替代芯片上。
stories.analysis: 从框架适配层切入是挑战 CUDA 生态的现实路径，但迁移成本仍是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

stories.title: 民主党人认为收紧 AI 监管可成为中期选举优势
stories.sourceTitle: Democrats think cracking down on AI could give them an edge
stories.summary: 若民主党在 11 月赢回国会控制权，将需要决定如何应对 AI 这一最新且棘手的政治议题；民调预测其至少翻转一个院。
stories.analysis: AI 监管正被包装成选举议题，未来立法节奏可能随政治周期波动。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Democrats could win back control of Congress this November, and if they do, they'll need to decide how to approach one of the country's newest and thorniest political issues: AI. Polls predict Democrats will flip at least one chamber of Congress in the midterm

stories.title: AI 陪伴应用 Tolan 获 3000 万美元融资，活跃用户超 25 万

stories.title: Replika 创始人推出个人 AI 助手 Wabi，兑现 12 年前 Disrupt 路演构想

stories.analysis: 老牌对话 AI 创业者转向通用助手，考验的是产品分发而非概念新颖度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

stories.title: Tenstorrent 以 62 亿美元估值融资 15 亿美元，扩大开放权重 AI 芯片

stories.title: 黑客用自主 AI Agent 集群入侵 John Deere、SharkNinja 等 100 多个网站
stories.sourceTitle: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

stories.title: 用户用 AI 让智能电视“变笨”：去除广告、跟踪和臃肿软件
stories.sourceTitle: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
stories.summary: 一些智能电视用户厌倦广告、追踪和卡顿界面，转而让 AI Agent 剥离预装软件并重新掌控电视。
stories.analysis: “反智能”需求说明消费电子过度商业化正在催生新的 AI 代理场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

stories.title: NVIDIA 发布新开放模型，推动企业在自有数据中心和 PC 上运行 Agent
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
stories.summary: NVIDIA 正押注企业希望在自有数据中心运行开放模型，并推动设备端私有 AI Agent 落地。
stories.analysis: NVIDIA 从卖芯片延伸到开放模型与 Agent 运行时，试图锁定企业本地 AI 栈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

stories.title: OpenAI 改进 ChatGPT 对低资源编程语言的支持，新增 SQLite 与 COBOL 迁移评测
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages

stories.analysis: 低资源语言和遗留系统迁移是编程 Agent 进入企业核心场景的高价值切口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

stories.title: Laplace Intelligence 用 AI Agent 和仿真在部署前对机器人、自动驾驶做红队测试

stories.analysis: 平台通过服务条款获取训练数据的做法，可能引发出版商和监管机构的更强反弹。

stories.title: 巴西 Itaú 银行用 ia.i 对话界面和 IARA 治理平台向全量客户推生成式 AI
stories.sourceTitle: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
stories.summary: Itaú 通过对话式界面 ia.i 和治理平台 IARA，在巴西高度监管的金融行业中把“AI First”战略同时用于客户和员工。

stories.title: Benefit Street Partners 用 OpenAI Codex 加速贷款估值比较与信贷协议分析

stories.analysis: Codex 在金融文档与内部工具开发中的价值，体现在缩短从问题到可运行工具的路径。

stories.title: OpenAI 教师节推巴西葡萄牙语版 AI for Educators，展示 Study Mode 如何引导提问式学习

stories.analysis: 教育场景的 AI 竞争正从答题转向教学过程设计，教师工作流是落地关键。

stories.analysis: 顶级律所参与定制法律 AI，说明专业服务正把模型能力嵌入高价值审查流程。
